title: PRD-10 synthetic risk input syntax

travelerRefs.description: required; 1–100 authorized traveler records. Sensitivity: restricted. Error: TRAVELER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

destinationCodes.description: required; 1–100 ISO/configured destination codes, unique. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: DESTINATION_UNSUPPORTED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

departureDate.description: required; valid itinerary-local date. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: DEPARTURE_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

returnDate.description: required for single trip; not before departure; duration contract-validated. Sensitivity: confidential. Error: RETURN_DATE_INVALID. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

tripTypeCode.description: required; offered single/multi-trip category. Sensitivity: internal. Error: TRIP_TYPE_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

assistancePlanCode.description: required; versioned assistance/coverage plan. Sensitivity: internal. Error: ASSISTANCE_PLAN_UNAVAILABLE. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

passportEvidenceRef.description: conditional by contract; restricted evidence, never analytics payload. Sensitivity: highly restricted. Error: TRAVEL_DOCUMENT_REQUIRED. Eligibility is contract-dependent.

description: Strict syntax baseline. Conditional predicates, cross-field dates/sums/relationships and actual carrier eligibility require the versioned application validator; passing this schema is not underwriting acceptance.
